title: Roboclock: A Unified Benchmark for Time-Aware Robotic Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2611.32233v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Time is a fundamental dimension of robotic intelligence: a robot may fail despite physically correct actions if it acts outside a valid time window, responds too slowly to an event, or fails to meet required throughput. Yet existing robotic benchmarks primarily emphasize spatial correctness and logical task completion, largely overlooking the temporal constraints of real-world applications. We present RoboClock, a unified benchmark for time-aware robotic manipulation featuring 60 tasks across five application domains. Mirroring these failure modes, RoboClock structures tasks around three types of temporal constraints: Temporal Window, Event-Reactive, and Throughput. Furthermore, RoboClock incorporates a Latency-Aligned evaluation protocol that continuously advances environment time during model inference and control-interface delays, paired with time-sensitive metrics. translated_title: RoboClock：面向时间感知机器人智能的统一基准
translated_abstract: 时间是机器人智能的一个基本维度：即使机器人的动作在物理上是正确的，如果它在无效的时间窗口内行动、对事件响应过慢，或无法满足所需的吞吐量，仍然可能失败。然而，现有的机器人基准主要强调空间正确性和逻辑任务完成，在很大程度上忽视了现实应用中的时间约束。我们提出了 RoboClock，一个面向时间感知机器人操作的统一基准，涵盖五个应用领域的60个任务。与这些失败模式相对应，RoboClock 围绕三种类型的时间约束来构建任务：时间窗口、事件响应和吞吐量。此外，RoboClock 引入了延迟对齐的评估协议，在模型推理和控制接口延迟期间持续推进环境时间，并配有时效敏感的评估指标。通过对超过30种方法的评估，我们发现表现最好的方法……
tldr: 提出 RoboClock 统一基准，通过涵盖五个领域的60个任务、三种时间约束（时间窗口、事件响应、吞吐量）以及延迟对齐评估协议，系统评估机器人智能中的时间感知能力。
en_tdlr: RoboClock, a unified benchmark featuring 60 tasks across five domains, systematically evaluates time-aware robotic intelligence through three temporal constraint types and a latency-aligned evaluation protocol.
